id: title:aspicer:delete replaced and evicted s3 blobs eagerly

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces S3 storage costs and read latency by deleting orphaned cached blobs immediately after a Redis pointer is replaced or evicted, rather than waiting for the 7-day S3 lifecycle rule.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F3.H3, P1.F2.H1, and P1.F2.H3 implements a substantive, bounded capability: replacing the reliance on S3 lifecycle rules with an eager, delayed deletion strategy backed by Redis-pointer-aware Lua scripts. observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; scoring is done after reviewing the complete group.

observations.behavior: Adds eager, delayed S3 blob deletion and Redis-pointer-aware Lua scripts, replacing the previous reliance on S3 lifecycle rules for orphaned blobs.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces S3 storage costs and read latency by deleting orphaned cached blobs immediately after a Redis pointer is replaced or evicted, rather than waiting for the 7-day S3 lifecycle rule. The delay preserves the window for a reader to complete its S3 fetch before the blob is removed.

observations.behavior: Adds Redis Lua scripts that atomically replace an entry and return the previous value only if it was an S3 pointer, and delete-entry scripts that return the previous value only if it was an S3 pointer.
observations.posthog_connection: These scripts support the eager-delete strategy: they keep the Redis and S3 state consistent by returning the pointer value only when replacing an entry, allowing the caller to schedule blob deletion. This avoids unnecessary S3 operations and keeps the cache size bounded.

observations.behavior: Registers the new Redis Lua scripts and uses them in set and eviction paths, scheduling delayed blob deletion when an old pointer is returned.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the Redis-pointer-aware replacement and deletion to the cache write and eviction paths, enabling the eager-delete behavior. This is the implementation of the new deletion strategy.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a test-only change. P1.F6.H4, P1.F6.H5, P1.F6.H6, P1.F6.H7, P1.F7.H1, P1.F8.H1.
